title: Duterte impeachment trial Day 45: Next witnesses to focus on Cale88 registration
summary: Three defense witnesses are set to take the stand on Friday, the 45th day of the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, to discuss the registration of Cale88 Foods Corp.
